  "endpoint_class": "mixed",
  "concordance_definition": "The study developed a bioinformatic pipeline integrating metabolic phenotype data, liver histology, and liver transcriptome benchmarked against human disease to create a MASLD ‘human proximity score’ (MHPS). The MHPS ranks murine models based on their congruence with human MASLD in terms of metabolic and/or fibro-inflammatory profiles.",
  "limitations_stated": [
    "Retrospective design constrained harmonization of study designs regarding fasting duration, sample sizes and statistical power.",
    "Most studies were conducted on male rodents, preventing exploration of gender differences.",
    "Available funds and resources limited model selection and expansion to include vast array of study designs and female animals.",
    "Could not examine relevance of murine models to heterogeneous subtypes of human MASLD (pediatric, lean, genetic risk variants).",
    "Murine models tested did not extend to advanced disease stages like cirrhosis, portal hypertension or hepatocellular carcinoma.",
    "Only data and samples from mice treated with semaglutide were available.",
    "Insufficient information on glucose metabolism in most models precluded systematic investigation of insulin resistance.",
    "Impact of thermoneutrality explored only in GAN-C2 model, cannot be generalized."
  ],
  "funding_conflict": null,
  "key_numbers": [
    "598 animals (509 WT/GA mice, 89 WT/GA rats) were collected.",
    "336 animals subjected to treatment (315 MASLD-inducing, 21 CCl4).",
    "262 animals as controls (247 MASLD controls, 15 CCl4 controls).",
    "39 models (study designs) aimed at modeling MASLD were included.",
    "Two time points for CCl4 (positive controls of MASLD-independent fibrosis).",
    "136 human transcriptomic data points (University of Cambridge (UCAM) and Virginia Commonwealth University (VCU)).",
    "168 human transcriptomic data points (Newcastle University (EPoS)).",
    "Approximately 50% alignment rate for DEGs between murine models and human data at the whole transcriptome level.",
    "The MHPS identified WD0.2%, WD2% and WD0.2%AMLD diets as most effective in mirroring metabolic burden of human MASLD.",
    "GAN-C2 diet fed to C57BL6/NTac or ob/ob mice was the most effective performance observed.",
    "CDAA diet in rats was the only diet inducing F4 fibrosis within a 12-week period.",
    "108 male mice in the 'Treatments' cohort.",
    "UCAM–VCU super-cohort: 136 patients (control n=4, mild F0 n=52, moderate F1–F2 n=50, severe F3–F4 n=30).",
    "EPoS database: 168 patients (mild F0 n=47, moderate F1–F2 n=64, severe F3–F4 n=57)."
  ]
